events.verdict: White (BOS) reaches in and initiates illegal contact to Siakam's (IND) wrist, causing him to slide his pivot foot. A foul should have been called on White instead of a traveling violation.
White (BOS) and Mathurin (IND) briefly engage and disengage off ball.
Jackson (IND) establishes himself in a wide screening position and the illegal lower body contact causes Pritchard (BOS) to lose his balance.
Mathurin (IND) reaches for the ball and the resulting contact with White (BOS) is marginal.

As White (BOS) makes a move to the basket, he bobbles the ball and regains possession with his right foot planted on the floor. He then maintains his pivot foot before stepping into his shooting motion.
Mathurin (IND) is drawn into the air towards White (BOS) as a result of the pump fake and although he brushes his side, the contact does not affect his shot attempt.
Toppin (IND) establishes himself in White's (BOS) path and absorbs the contact as the two players come together.
Nesmith (IND) initiates illegal contact across Tatum's (BOS) wrist before getting to the ball.
Brown (BOS) reaches in and makes clean contact with the ball that causes Mathurin (IND) to lose possession.
Brown (BOS) wraps his arm around Mathurin's (IND) leg and pulls him, affecting his ability to pursue the loose ball.
Pritchard (BOS) and Siakam (IND) briefly engage and disengage following the pick.

At the start of Siakam's (IND) drive, he lowers his head into Brown's (BOS) outstretched arm. Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Queta (BOS) cleanly blocks Sheppard's (IND) layup attempt.
Haliburton (IND) makes contact with Tatum's (BOS) arm that affects his driving shot attempt.
Pritchard (BOS) legally contests Haliburton's (IND) jump shot attempt.
Haliburton (IND) legally contests Tatum's (BOS) jump shot attempt.
White (BOS) makes contact with the ball as he contests Haliburton's (IND) jump shot attempt and there is no illegal contact on the play.
Haliburton (IND) releases his shot attempt before returning to the floor.
Pritchard (BOS) rests a hand against McConnell's (IND) side without applying force during the driving shot attempt.
Siakam (IND) and Brown's (BOS) arms briefly become tangled during the rebound.
Brown (BOS) legally contests Mathurin's (IND) driving shot attempt.
Tatum (BOS) firms up in a screening position in McConnell's (IND) path and does not deliver contact as he retracts his arms against his own body.
Queta (BOS) and Toppin (IND) engage as they elevate in pursuit of the rebound and the contact on the play is marginal.
Mathurin (IND) legally contests Brown's (BOS) jump shot attempt.
Haliburton (IND) is drawn into the air towards Pritchard (BOS) and he initiates arm and body contact, which affects Pritchard's layup attempt at the basket.
Haliburton (IND) avoids making any illegal contact with White (BOS) during the layup attempt at the basket.
Toppin (IND) touches the ball after it comes into contact with the backboard and is above rim-level with a chance to score.

Brown (BOS) rests and removes his left hand from Siakam's (IND) side as he enters his upward shooting motion and this contact is marginal. Brown then contests the shot attempt and incidental "high-five" contact occurs with Siakam (IND) after the release.
Sheppard (IND) briefly has both arms around White (BOS) and immediately releases, allowing White to move freely.
Tatum (BOS) places his off-arm against Siakam's (IND) body and releases from the contact.
Pritchard (BOS) and Sheppard (IND) both have their hands on the ball and any contact between the two players is incidental. A held ball is correctly whistled.
Pritchard (BOS) has both hands on the ball when Indiana attempts to make a timeout request. Since Indiana is not in possession of the ball, officials do not award a timeout to the Pacers.
Siakam (IND) and Tatum (BOS) briefly engage and disengage during the jump ball.
White (BOS) legally contests Siakam's (IND) jump shot attempt.
Pritchard (BOS) loses his balance and as him and Mathurin (IND) come together at the same spot on the floor and the contact is incidental.
Mathurin (IND) legally contests Brown's (BOS) jump shot attempt.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Brown's (BOS) jump shot attempt goes out of bounds and Indiana is correctly given possession.
Haliburton (IND) legally reestablishes himself in the court of play prior to coming into contact with the ball.
